name: data-cleanup
description: Clean a CSV: dedupe, normalize, fix types; outputs cleaned CSV + report

rules.default: trim whitespace, dedupe exact rows, normalize dates to ISO-8601, fix obvious type errors

constraints: Read {input} but never modify it. Write clean.py (python3 stdlib csv only), cleaned.csv and cleanup_report.md (rows in/out, what changed, rows dropped and why) in the job directory.
done_when: cleaned.csv and cleanup_report.md exist, clean.py reproduces cleaned.csv from {input}, and the report's row counts match.
